title: Signature Duo 49 · Hourglass SSBBW × Hourglass SSBBW · Dancheong × Celadon Sanggam · Palace Eaves
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, two matching enormous hourglass figures.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — early 40s, sleek center-parted low bun with a gold binyeo. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body. Body Art: Full body Korean dancheong body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. Glossy celadon green, vermilion, cobalt blue, and golden yellow in the style of palace eave painting, large layered lotus medallions and continuous cloud scrolls. The lotus medallions spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — mid 40s, sleek high chignon with a jade binyeo. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body. Body Art: Full body Goryeo celadon painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. High-gloss jade-green celadon glaze with fine crackle, densely inlaid with black-and-white sanggam lotus arabesques and flying cranes. The lotus arabesques spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing full frontal in a wide stance, arms relaxed slightly away from the body. The right woman — standing facing the camera in a relaxed contrapposto, her weight on one leg so that enormous hip juts far outward, the other heel lifted, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules; the right woman wears extremely high celadon platform stiletto mules. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: Beneath the eaves of a Korean royal palace hall, painted dancheong rafters and red columns softly out of focus, warm daylight glowing beyond, the background much lighter than their bodies, warm bounce light carving the deep inward curve of the waist and the huge curves of the bust and hips, making the glossy colors gleam on the left and making the jade glaze glow on the right, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
